# Public SDK snapshot

`actionlint-extension-api` contains the public SDK from actionlint's
`crates/actionlint-extension-api`, including its MIT license. The snapshot adds
the versioned tool-integration and source-files interfaces before their first
published SDK revision. It contains no host implementation or sibling-checkout
dependency. Replace the entire snapshot with a published SDK revision once
available; do not update generated protocol sources independently.
